interface.signature: def validateBinaryTreeNodes(n: int, leftChild: List[int], rightChild: List[int]) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 10,000.
The lengths of leftChild and rightChild arrays must both be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= x <= n - 1 for x in leftChild + rightChild)
preconditions.description: Each element in leftChild and rightChild must be between -1 and n-1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (num_roots == 1 and num_nodes == n and is_acyclic and is_connected)
postconditions.description: The function returns true if there is exactly one root, the number of nodes is equal to n, the tree is acyclic, and the tree is connected.
